newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-RIEDLE STRIKES TWICE TO GIVE DORTMUND HALFTIME LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIEDLE STRIKES TWICE TO GIVE DORTMUND HALFTIME LEAD.

text.p: Two goals within five minutes by Karlheinz Riedle gave Borussia Dortmund a surprise 2-0 lead over Juventus after the Italians had dominated most of the first half of the European Cup final on Wednesday.

In the 29th minute the German international controlled a cross from Scot Paul Lambert with his chest on the left-hand side of the box and fired the ball crispy into the back of the net with his left foot.
Riedle then rose at a corner to head the ball home for his second.

The goals were completely against the run of play, Juventus looking a class above their German opponents for much of the half. Dortmund had not had a shot on goal until Riedle took his first opportunity.
Juventus went desperately close to scoring three minutes before the interval when Zinedine Zidane hit the post.
A minute later Juventus got the ball into the net but Christian Vieri was judged to have handled the ball before he fired home.
